newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Q3 GM estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon raises Q3 GM estimate.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers auto analyst Jack Kirnan said he raised his third quarter earnings estimate for General Motors Corp to $0.75 a share from $0.65. His full year GM estimates remain at $6.25 a share for 1996 and $6.75 for 1997.

-- The analyst said in a research report that the higher third quarter estimate reflects modestly stronger production in GM's North American operations in September, as overall volume rose 17,000 units above the targeted level for the month. He said the stronger volume reflects better startup experience for new models, including the Pontiac Grand Prix and the Buick Park Avenue.
